name: Enantiophoenix
sum: Cenomanian enantiornithean from the Sannine Formation of Lebanon found with lumps of amber.
holotype: A partial skeleton from the Cenomanian of Lebanon (number in Cau and Arduini 2008).
exceptional: Small lumps of amber preserved with the specimen.
biology: The amber suggests it may have fed on tree sap.
author: Cau and Arduini 2008

sources.text: Cau, A. 2008. ''Enantiophoenix electrophyla'' gen. et sp. nov. (Aves, Enantiornithes) from the Upper Cretaceous (Cenomanian) of Lebanon and its phylogenetic relationships. Atti della Societa Italiana di Scienze Naturali e del Museo Ivico di Storia Naturale in Milano 149(2): 293–324.
